correctness.rationale: In every maximum independent set, ordered cyclic gaps are q+s_i (q=k+1), nonnegative excess sum 2, so only a two-unit gap A or two one-unit gaps B occur. Legal slides are transfers of one or two units to adjacent gaps and give exactly 4 neighbors each including m=2. Exhaustive local transfer-direction analysis classifies all triangles and simple squares, yielding A link path (two triangles, one square) and B link four-cycle, with special m=2 row. Edges have two incident faces except A-A double-transfer edges with one, producing a surface. Counting face-edge incidences gives N3=n and N4=n(m−1)/2, χ=0. Boundary A_x~A_{x±q} gives gcd(n,q)=gcd(2,q) components, connectedness via unit-transfer paths; surface classification yields Möbius/annulus. Independently enumerated all triangles/quadrilaterals, links, boundary and connectivity for small k,m. Finite checks alone are not all-parameter proof.

value.rationale: This is the first interacting two-vacancy sector of close-packed independent sets; the full short-cycle filling has a natural nontrivial topology with sharp parity switch and uniform exact cells, not an arbitrary numerical slice.

final_claim: For k,m>=2, n=(k+1)m+2, graph of maximum independent sets of C_n^k under token sliding has V=n(m+1)/2, E=n(m+1), N3=n, N4=n(m−1)/2. Filling every simple triangle/four-cycle gives connected surface Möbius for even k, annulus for odd k.
limitations: Only k,m>=2 and exactly 2 spare positions; polygonal short-cycle filling is distinct from clique complex.
